questions.stem: A 32-year-old marathon runner is undergoing a cardiovascular evaluation as part of a sports medicine clinic assessment. Considering physiological effects on the cardiovascular system, w hich of the following conditions or activities are most likely to be associated with an increase in cardiac output? Experiencing acute emotional stress Undergoing vigorous physical exercise Advanced stages of pregnancy Participating in deep meditation practices
